rationale: The three bounds never described one resource: 64 records of 32768 bytes needs 2097152 against a declared 65536, so the file stopped at 12. Derived instead: max_record_bytes 12288 covers the 10222-byte largest real record, and 21 x 12288 = 258048 = max_bytes, so the declared capacity is exactly fundable and records bind first (258048 at the 5171-byte real mean funds 49). Both record bounds come DOWN. The portable cap moves 131072 to 262144, which two siblings already compile.
